+- Copilot records ranged command/skill completion-reference identity and presentation paired with the original composer text under `copilot.completionReferences` in its chat database's generic turn-scoped `session_metadata`, owned by the host turn ID through a foreign key and separate from session-global metadata. Skills are standard resource attachments with `displayKind: 'skill'`, the authoritative host-space `uri`, and the slash-command `label`; `_meta` is optional presentation/provider data, never skill identity. They remain UI references rather than SDK file context or new sandbox grants; the slash text invokes the skill. Legacy Simple skill attachments are decoded at history restoration boundaries and, for positively identified VS Code hosts only, at the completion-response compatibility boundary. That metadata-based format was deprecated on 2026-11-12. History reads join the owning turn's SDK event ID to restore these references. The host supplies the pre-contribution original text in the send context, independently of the model prompt; direct provider invocations default to their prompt, and steering retains its original pending-message text. Restored ranges apply to that exact text, not contributed host context or the sanitized SDK prompt. Real SDK attachment ordinals merge forwarded references without duplicating model text; UI-only references never reach the SDK. Fork remapping and truncation update or delete these records through foreign-key cascades, without separate pruning or another SDK history read.

- Optionally admitting provider-native metadata through `onDidChatSessionEvent` for environment-owned SDK mirroring. History reads receive exact chat/context plus an acknowledged journal cursor; they never create or resume a runtime.
